name: ai-meeting-summarizer
description: Personal meeting companion: capture, transcribe, attribute and summarize meetings.

scripts.setup: npm run setup:light && npm run setup:ai
scripts.start: npm run db:up && npm run db:migrate && npm run dev
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix backend run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck
scripts.test: npm run test:api && npm run test:ai && npm run test:scripts
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && npm --prefix frontend run build && npm run check:ownership
scripts.setup:light: npm install && cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
